description: Computes selling fees, net profit, margin and ROI for one sale on Amazon, eBay or Etsy from the sale price, shipping and costs. Category sets the default fee rate: amazon: default (15%), electronics (8%), computers (7%), clothing (17%), home (15%), toys (15%), books (15%); ebay: default (13.25%), electronics (9%), books (14.95%), clothing (13.25%); etsy: default (6.5%). Rates are 2026 estimates and vary by region; pass fee_rate_percent to override. Currency-agnostic. Free.

category.description: Category id for the default fee rate (see description).

fba_fee.description: Amazon FBA fulfilment fee, if any.

name: calculate_marketplace_fees
